# Find the image you remember.

A private, local AI gallery built for Windows. Find any photo by what it shows or the words inside it, then let AI rename it.

Free from Microsoft Store · Windows 11

Search naturally

## Describe it. Finds it.

One search box can understand what a photo shows, read words with on-device OCR, or narrow the library by name and path.

Review before applying

## AI rename.

Magic Rename proposes a concise filename for every selected image. Edit each suggestion, review the list, and apply only when it looks right.

Act on the results

## Select, move, copy, rename or delete.

A result set is ready to work with. Select the images you need and perform a file action without leaving the search; indexing never moves originals on its own.

Private by design
